adopt.open.zh: 接管 TikTok 广告活动

adopt.title.zh: 接管 TikTok 广告活动

adopt.help.en: For a campaign made in TikTok Ads Manager by copying one Studio launched. Studio reads it from TikTok and starts tracking its spend and results. Nothing is changed on TikTok.
adopt.help.zh: 用于在 TikTok Ads Manager 里复制 Studio 投放而生成的广告活动。Studio 会从 TikTok 读取它，并开始跟踪花费和结果，不会改动 TikTok 上的任何内容。

adopt.idHint.en: The number under the campaign's name in Ads Manager
adopt.idHint.zh: Ads Manager 里广告活动名称下方的数字

adopt.noteHint.en: Who asked for this and why

adopt.done.en: Adopted. Studio now tracks this campaign.
adopt.done.zh: 已接管，Studio 现在会跟踪这个广告活动。
